_comment: Self-rated, hand-written rather than computed from repo byte counts.
A byte-count chart puts JavaScript on top, because the public repos are side projects
and the work that pays is not open source. Accurate about GitHub, wrong about him.
Axis order is the order they are read, starting at twelve o'clock: DevOps and AI first,
then the Linux and telephony work that backs them up. Scores are a judgement, not a
measurement. Keep language notes under ~28 characters or the gauge legend clips them.
